# Nykaa Fashion Marketplace Canonical Card Pack — V17 Production Ready Final

## 0. Issue Register and Curation Notes

```yaml
issue_register:
- issue_id: nykaa.semantic_embedding_quality
  status: resolved
  resolution: All column embedding text regenerated by semantic role from Nykaa DOCX-backed table meaning; copied safety tails
    removed.
- issue_id: nykaa.v1_9_edge_coverage
  status: preserved
  resolution: Started from edge-coverage-complete v1.9 pack; deterministic edges retained.
```

## 1. Scope

Reusable Nykaa Fashion marketplace canonical semantics for the five documented source tables: OMS, settlement, addition charge, mapper GST, and entity mapping.
